decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - REFUSE - Not Permitted DevelopmentReason:The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that the proposed side and rear infill extension (4.39m x 4.95m with a maximum height of 2.93m) received on the 28th April 2009, and verified on site on the 29th April 2009, as shown on the drawings submitted on 28th April 2009 and numbered 09101SR.EX001 and 09101SR.GA101 was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:The development fails to comply with the terms of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A, Clause (e) (i) and A.3(a) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended in 2008) because the depth of the extension would be greater than 3m from the rear wall of the dwelling and the proposed materials would not be of a similar appearance to those used in the existing dwellinghouse.
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the demolition of the existing single storey rear extension and the erection of a single storey side extension to the house
